summary: Backend testing completed. All 18 tests PASSED (100%). Verified 'amperage' has been COMPLETELY REMOVED from CustomerCreate/Customer models (grep on server.py returns 0 hits). POST /api/customers succeeds without amperage; POST with legacy amperage is silently ignored (Pydantic default extra='ignore') and does NOT appear in response. GET /api/customers, GET /api/customers/{id}, and PUT /api/customers/{id} all return objects with no 'amperage' key. Full flow customer -> reading -> invoice at $0.85/kWh works (100 kWh -> $85.00 total). Regression: exactly 3 seed generators, dashboard.total_generators=3, auth & all report endpoints healthy.

minor.issue: Legacy 'amperage' field is silently dropped due to default Pydantic extra='ignore'. Consider `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')` on CustomerCreate to catch stale mobile clients explicitly (return 422 instead of masking the drop).
Client-supplied total_amount is trusted verbatim rather than computed server-side from consumption_charge (0.85/kWh) + previous_balance - risk of client tampering / inconsistent totals.
No auth guard on any endpoint - login endpoint returns no token/session. Only relevant for production hardening.

action_items: Frontend: main agent should verify the customer create/edit form no longer shows an amperage input and that customer list/detail screens do not attempt to render customer.amperage (will be undefined).
Optional: enforce `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')` on CustomerCreate to reject legacy amperage payloads explicitly (currently silently ignored).
Optional: compute total_amount server-side from consumption_charge + previous_balance so invoice math cannot drift from the $0.85/kWh rule.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses Pydantic v1 `.dict()` and deprecated `@app.on_event('shutdown')`; migrate to `.model_dump()` and lifespan handlers.
Admin credentials (MS / Ms28796610**) are hardcoded in server.py - move to env vars before production.
server.py is 683 lines - close to the 700-line threshold; consider splitting routers per resource (customers/generators/invoices/reports).
InvoiceCreate.total_amount is client-supplied instead of derived; server should compute from consumption_charge to enforce the $0.85/kWh policy.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed customers/readings/invoices and clean up via DELETE /api/customers/{id} in try/finally. No permanent data added.
